tiers.GT0_UNREVIEWED: No historical label and no independent human review; excluded from metrics.
tiers.GT1_HISTORICAL_ONLY: Historical FortiSIEM/ML label only; masked during blind review and excluded from benchmark accuracy.
tiers.IN_PROGRESS: Draft saved by reviewer; does not advance GT state or unlock post-cert comparison.
tiers.GT2_SINGLE_REVIEW: 1 independent reviewer locked; exploratory only when explicitly enabled.
tiers.CONFLICT_PENDING_ADJUDICATION: Reviewer 1 and Reviewer 2 locked conflicting verdicts; requires independent Senior/Admin adjudication.
tiers.GT3_CERTIFIED: 2 distinct reviewers locked agreeing TP/FP verdicts OR conflict adjudicated by independent Senior/Admin.
tiers.CERTIFIED_INCONCLUSIVE: Dual reviewers or Senior Adjudicator certified INCONCLUSIVE; excluded from binary TP/FP accuracy.

invariants: Reviewer who participated in conflict cannot adjudicate (HTTP 403)
Locked reviews never overwrite historical labels and never write LearningRecord
